components_and_sections.description: Sticky glassmorphism navigation bar with brand logo 'KHADKA EV', nav links, bilingual toggle (EN/NE), and header CTAs for Direct Call & WhatsApp.
Large line-by-line masked headline reveal, sub-headline, floating key badges, and interactive/parallax presentation of Tata Curvv EV hero visual.

Direct Call & WhatsApp 'Book Your Ride' action buttons
Trust pills: 100% Electric, Owner-Driven Sitaram Khadka, 5-Star NCAP Safety

components_and_sections.description: Numbered manifesto chapters (01 Owner & Chauffeur, 02 Luxury Tata Curvv EV, 03 Eastern Nepal Specialist, 04 Zero Emission Comfort) detailing Sitaram Khadka's personal dedication to private, safe, ultra-quiet travel.
features: Chapter numbers in large mono font

features: Deep-link WhatsApp enquiry per service option
'WhatsApp for Price' button on each card

Slow luxury kinetic text ticker continuously moving horizontally.

components_and_sections.description: Frequently asked questions regarding booking process, charging stops, luggage space, driver language, and payment options.

components_and_sections.description: Comprehensive form allowing users to enter Full Name, Phone, Pickup Location, Destination, Date, Time, Trip Type, Passengers, and Special Message. On submit, formats a neat WhatsApp text string and triggers `https://wa.me/9779802759592?text=...`.
features: Dynamic form validation with prefilled deep link trigger

components_and_sections.description: Contact info cards (Phone: +977 9763743940, WhatsApp: +977 9802759592, Facebook link, Location: Itahari, Sunsari, Nepal) plus embedded Google Map.
Fixed bottom bar on mobile viewports for effortless 1-tap conversion.
Site-wide floating circular WhatsApp button in bottom-right corner.

instructions_to_main_agent.general: Build a single-page premium scroll website for Khadka Car Rental Service in React with Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion. Ensure language toggle (English/Nepali) updates all text smoothly.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing_requirement: EVERY interactive element (buttons, links, form inputs, language toggle, accordion items, service cards, mobile bar) MUST include clear data-testid attributes.
instructions_to_main_agent.booking_flow: No online payment or fare calculator. Every price inquiry redirects to direct Call (9763743940) or WhatsApp (9802759592) deep links with descriptive pre-filled text.
